modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and loads database path/read-only configuration from an environment mapping.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the Order dataclass used as the service's domain record.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: Provides SQLite-backed order schema initialization, inserts, and lookups through OrderRepository.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds in-memory order event dictionaries for API responses; it does not persist audit records.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Transforms HTTP payloads into Orders, saves them, and formats create/get responses.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST and GET order endpoints on an app adapter.

modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: CLI bootstrap that loads environment settings, constructs a repository, initializes SQLite schema, and reports readiness.

modules.name: minisvc
modules.purpose: Package export marker; no business runtime logic.

modules.name: minisvc.storage
modules.purpose: Package marker; no business runtime logic.

modules.name: minisvc.api
modules.purpose: Package marker; no business runtime logic.

key_functions.description: Maps MINISVC_DB (default orders.sqlite) and MINISVC_READONLY == 1 into a frozen Settings object.
Loads os.environ, constructs OrderRepository, initializes the orders table, prints readiness, and returns 0; the readonly setting is not applied.
Stores the configured database path as a pathlib.Path.
Creates the orders table if absent using a SQLite transaction context.
Inserts one Order into SQLite; duplicate primary keys and database errors propagate.
Queries by order_id and reconstructs an Order or returns None.
Binds POST /orders to create_order and GET /orders/<order_id> to get_order via lambdas.
Reads required payload keys, coerces total_cents with int(), saves the order once, and returns a created response with an in-memory event.
Returns missing for absent orders or serialized order data plus a read event for found orders.
Creates a dictionary containing order type, action, ID, and total; no storage call occurs.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: main calls repo.init_schema() to create orders if needed
main prints readiness and returns exit code 0

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents and constructs Order
create_order calls repo.save(order), inserting into SQLite
handler returns status, order_id, and the transient event dictionary
